review: 702.131d: skip reason was false (an entering token can both raise the count to ten and meet a power-conditioned enters trigger); removed the skip and added 702.131d-1 with Illustrious Wanderglyph's Gnome and Garruk's Packleader.

scenarios.title: Resolving a spell with ascend gives the city's blessing at ten permanents
decisions: A casts Secrets of the Golden City, tapping three Islands.
Both players pass; Secrets of the Golden City resolves.

variants.label: ten_permanents
variants.expected: A controls ten permanents when the spell resolves, gets the city's blessing and draws three cards: A's hand holds 3 Plains, A's library holds 2. Secrets of the Golden City goes to A's graveyard.

variants.label: nine_permanents
variants.expected: A controls nine permanents when the spell resolves, does not get the city's blessing and draws two cards: A's hand holds 2 Plains, A's library holds 3. B's three Mountains do not count. Secrets of the Golden City goes to A's graveyard.

scenarios.title: A permanent with ascend gives the blessing as soon as its controller has ten permanents
decisions: No spells or abilities are used; the board is observed in A's first main phase after state-based actions.

variants.label: ten_permanents
variants.expected: A controls ten permanents (Snubhorn Sentry and nine Plains), has the city's blessing, and Snubhorn Sentry is a 3/3.

variants.label: nine_permanents
variants.expected: A controls nine permanents and does not have the city's blessing; Snubhorn Sentry stays a 0/3. B's two Mountains do not count.

scenarios.title: The city's blessing stays after the controller drops below ten permanents
decisions: B casts Stone Rain targeting one of A's Plains, tapping three Mountains.
Both players pass; Stone Rain resolves and the state-based check follows.

variants.label: already_blessed
variants.expected: The targeted Plains moves to A's graveyard and A controls nine permanents, but A already has the city's blessing, so Snubhorn Sentry stays a 3/3.

variants.label: never_blessed
variants.delta: A starts with 8 Plains instead of 9, so A never had ten permanents.
variants.expected: The targeted Plains moves to A's graveyard and A controls eight permanents. A has never had the city's blessing, so Snubhorn Sentry stays a 0/3.

scenarios.forge_notes: The blessing is granted by a state check on the opening board, so the base variant relies on Forge granting it before B's spell resolves.

scenarios.title: The blessing's continuous effects apply before the entering token is checked against a trigger

setup.notes: A controls nine permanents and does not have the city's blessing at the start of A's upkeep.

decisions: Illustrious Wanderglyph's upkeep trigger goes on the stack; both players pass and it resolves, creating a 1/1 colorless Gnome artifact creature token for A.
If Garruk's Packleader triggers, A chooses to draw; both players pass and the trigger resolves.

variants.label: tenth_permanent
variants.expected: The Gnome token is A's tenth permanent: A gets the city's blessing and the token is a 3/3 when triggers are checked, so Garruk's Packleader's trigger fires and A draws a Forest (library 1 card).

variants.label: ninth_permanent
variants.delta: A controls six Plains instead of seven.
variants.expected: The Gnome token is A's ninth permanent: A does not get the city's blessing, the token stays a 1/1, Garruk's Packleader's trigger does not fire and A's library keeps 2 cards.

scenarios.forge_notes: Relies on Forge granting the blessing and applying Wanderglyph's static bonus before it evaluates the powerGE3 condition of Packleader's ChangesZone trigger.
